page_title: EVE 3-0 NOT | Everton v Nottingham Forest 06/12/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+3' The referee demonstrates he won't tolerate this behaviour. Jake O'Brien (Everton) is given a yellow card.
90' We will have 3 min. of added time.
88' Beto (Everton) climbs high to connect with a cross near the penalty spot but plants a header well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Nottingham will have a goal kick.
87' Vitali Mykolenko (Everton) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
86' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Tyler Dibling (Everton) comes onto the pitch for Jack Grealish.
84' Vitali Mykolenko (Everton) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Chris Kavanagh had an easy-decision to make.

80' 3 - 0 Goal! Jake O'Brien displays great vision and sends a pass to Kiernan Dewsbury-Hall (Everton), who shows brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball into the bottom right corner. The score is 3:0.
80' James Garner (Everton) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
78' James Garner (Everton) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.

78' Wonder save! Dwight McNeil (Everton) picked up the ball and hit a beautiful curling shot from the edge of the box. Matz Sels saw it late but somehow got his fingers to the ball to keep it out. Everton have been awarded a corner kick.

75' Kiernan Dewsbury-Hall (Everton) latches onto a short pass just on the edge of the box and shoots. The effort beats the keeper but comes back off the left post. Close! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Nottingham.
73' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Dwight McNeil (Everton) will replace Carlos Alcaraz.
73' James Tarkowski (Everton) makes a bad tackle on his opponent and is angry when the referee shows him a deserved yellow card.
73' The ball is out of play and Everton manage to earn a corner.
72' The resulting corner from James Garner (Everton) is cleared by the defence. Everton force their opponents to concede a corner.
72' James Garner (Everton) delivers a crossfield pass, but the ball is cut out before it reaches its intended target. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Everton.
71' James Garner (Everton) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger. The ball has crossed the sideline. Everton are taking a throw-in.

66' Nicolas Dominguez (Nottingham) is the first to arrive to a rebound inside the penalty area and unleashes a quick low strike towards the middle of the goal that beats the keeper. One of the defenders, however, makes a superb goal-line clearance.
62' Nicolas Dominguez (Nottingham) comes onto the pitch because Ryan Yates simply cannot continue any longer after picking up an injury.
62' The substitution is prepared. Beto (Everton) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Thierno Barry.
61' Ryan Yates (Nottingham) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
57' Thierno Barry (Everton) is awarded a yellow card. The referee showed him no mercy.
57' None of the Nottingham players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.
57' A first-time shot by Neco Williams (Nottingham) inside the box is unwittingly blocked by one of his own players. Corner kick. Nottingham will have an opportunity.
56' James Garner (Everton) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots low to the middle of the goal, but Matz Sels pulls off an exquisite save to deny him.
54' Nikola Milenkovic (Nottingham) makes a really bad tackle on his opponent and is relieved when the referee only shows him a yellow card.
52' An accurate cross finds its way to Igor Jesus (Nottingham) who sends in a bullet header towards the bottom right corner from just outside the box, but the goalkeeper makes the save.
50' Vitali Mykolenko (Everton) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a precise pass. He pulls the trigger but only hits one of the opposition, who gets in the way of his effort.
46' Sean Dyche makes a switch. Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham) is coming on in place of Dan Ndoye at the start of the second period.
46' Half-time substitution. Nicolo Savona (Nottingham) will not participate anymore and Zach Abbott is coming on.
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Ibrahim Sangare (Nottingham) comes off for Ryan Yates.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+5' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+3' Morato (Nottingham) was probably a bit loose with his words to Chris Kavanagh, who decides to show him a yellow.
45+3' 2 - 0 Thierno Barry (Everton) latches on to a precise pass inside the box and sends in a superb strike that finds its way into the bottom right corner.
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
45' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
45' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) meets the lofted pass inside the box with a well placed shot towards the bottom right corner, but Jordan Pickford pulls off a fantastic save to deny him.
41' Everton keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
37' A player from Nottingham commits a rough challenge. Chris Kavanagh blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
33' A cross from a corner kick by Nottingham is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
32' Nottingham can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

32' A lofted cross from Dan Ndoye (Nottingham) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. Nottingham force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
28' Kiernan Dewsbury-Hall (Everton) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
28' Iliman Ndiaye (Everton) unleashes a bullet of a shot that is blocked by a defender. The ball goes out of play. Everton are awarded a corner kick.
27' Everton earn a corner.
27' A cross into the box from Kiernan Dewsbury-Hall (Everton) is cleared. The linesman points to the corner flag, Everton are going to take it.
23' An attempted cross from Jake O'Brien (Everton) is cleared.
20' Everton are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
15' Ibrahim Sangare (Nottingham) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
13' Igor Jesus (Nottingham) blows a chance to score! He pinged a fine header from deep inside the box towards the net, but his aim was off and it flew narrowly wide of the left post.
13' Neco Williams (Nottingham) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target.
11' Morato (Nottingham) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
11' Dan Ndoye (Nottingham) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
8' Morato (Nottingham) commits a rough challenge and Chris Kavanagh blows his whistle for an infringement.
6' Everton seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
2' 1 - 0 Nikola Milenkovic (Nottingham) gets on the scoresheet, but unfortunately for him it's an own goal.
1' Nicolo Savona (Nottingham) is shown a yellow card by the referee.
1' The first half has started.
The players are on the pitch and Everton will have the kick-off.
Chris Kavanagh will officiate today.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
